channel.title: Heather Lyn Wilson
channel.description: Faith, leadership, and what stood out from my Bible reading. New posts Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

item.title: Psalm 71:18
item.description: Everything you have walked through, every prayer God answered, every hard thing He carried you through — it was not just for you. It was so you would have something to hand to the ones coming next.

item.title: Psalm 59:12
item.description: Pride does not free people. It captures them. That is a very different picture than the one our culture is painting.

item.title: Psalm 56:4
item.description: They can hurt me. They can lie about me. They can walk away. They can make my life difficult in a thousand ways. But they cannot touch the part of me that belongs to God.

item.title: Psalm 50:14 & 23
item.description: Everything in you wants to focus on what is going wrong. And in that moment, choosing thankfulness costs something. You are laying down your right to complain. That kind of thankfulness is worship.

item.title: Psalm 40:5
item.description: He answers a prayer and we say thank you and get on with our day. He rescues us and we exhale and go back to normal. We forget. Not because we are ungrateful. Just because we are moving.

item.title: Psalm 33:10
item.description: Panic assumes God is not in charge. Faith assumes He is. And when I remember that He frustrates the plans of the nations, I can breathe again.

item.title: Not Clapbacks or Receipts
item.description: Because a life of integrity doesn't need to defend itself the way a life without it does. The truth stands on its own over time, and character speaks louder than accusations.

item.title: Psalm 19:13
item.description: What are the deliberate sins I have made peace with? The ones I keep doing because I have talked myself into believing they do not really count.

item.title: Psalm 18:39
item.description: There have been seasons where I have had to be strong. Not because I found it in myself. Because God armed me with it.

item.title: Psalm 4:4
item.description: Sleep on it. And be quiet in the meantime. That is such practical wisdom. Especially the silent part.

item.title: Psalm 2:12
item.description: You bow to Him and find joy. Or you do not, and you get consumed by your own life.

item.title: Job 42:17
item.description: Full does not mean happy every day. It does not mean easy. It means whole. Complete. Rounded out with everything a real life includes.

item.title: Job 42:3
item.description: He was not being sarcastic. He is not defeated. He is humbled. He is finally in the right place.

item.title: Job 33:10
item.description: We go through a hard season and we start to make it about us in a way that is not even true.

item.title: Job 28:28
item.description: We talk a lot about wisdom. We rarely talk about where it actually comes from.

item.title: If Only There Was a Mediator…
item.description: He could not have pictured a manger or a cross. But he felt the gap so deeply that he cried out for someone who could bring God and man together.

item.title: How Can a Good God…?
item.description: Sitting in ashes, having lost everything, Job answers the most-asked question in the world in one sentence.

item.title: While He Was Still Speaking
item.description: One messenger has not even finished before another shows up with worse news. And then another. The first thing Job did was fall on his face in worship.

item.title: Job's Regular Practice
item.description: Long before Job lost everything, he was just a dad who got up early to intercede for his kids. Not panic prayer. A rhythm.

item.title: Maybe I Have Had a Hard-Fought Hallelujah
item.description: Standing in church singing about a hard-fought hallelujah, I realized I actually have had a few. I just don't reach for them first when I think about my life.
